correctness.rationale: The step decomposition rigorously identifies BV seminorm operator norms with column sums of a gradient matrix. The exact nonnegative bidiagonal matrix was derived by counting all insertion positions. Monotone coupling proves that the last column maximizes every power; its geometric stage times have precisely the coupon-collector completion law. Inclusion-exclusion yields the exact finite formula and factorial-moment convergence the critical profile. The reverse-shuffle coefficient is separately computed from step inputs, with boundary cases n=2 and n=3 stated. Exact rational direct-permutation and occupancy tests confirm n<=11,r<=25.

value.rationale: This determines a mathematically natural stability invariant at every deck size and horizon for a standard shuffle, with an unexpected exact coupon-collector survival identity and explicit critical scaling. The first loss of naive geometric decay and reversal between adjoint shuffles are sharp structural phenomena rather than a parameter substitution or a finite table. It quantifies how random rearrangement affects ordered numerical data, independently of permutation mixing norms.
